hunks.baseline: He had spent a full jiazi standing before vats of boiling molten iron.
hunks.sol: He had spent a full jiazi standing before vats of boiling molten iron.[^1]

hunks.baseline: Once he started something, he had always seen it through to the end. He had forgotten people and love alike. The anvil and hammer had been his friends and lovers.
hunks.sol: Once he started something, he had always seen it through to the end. He had forgotten people and love alike. The anvil and hammer had been his friends and his beloved.

hunks.baseline: I had wondered why there were so many old men named Jang in such a tiny village, but it turned out to be a clan village.[^1] Half the people we passed on the road had the family name Jang.
hunks.sol: I had wondered why there were so many old men named Jang in a village no bigger than a booger, but it turned out to be a clan village.[^2] Half the people we passed on the road had the family name Jang.

hunks.baseline: That bastard Cheongpung had done nothing but eat from start to finish.
hunks.sol: That bastard Cheongpung had done nothing but stuff his face the whole time.

hunks.baseline: “Over there. At the edge of the village.”
hunks.sol: “Waaay over there. At the edge of the village.”

hunks.baseline: “What if it isn’t him? Let’s start by searching the nearby area and work our way along.”
hunks.sol: “What if we go and it isn’t him? Let’s start by searching the nearby area and work our way along.”

hunks.baseline: While I wondered whether I should simply hurl away that food bundle, the boy boldly held out both his little hands toward Cheongpung.
hunks.sol: While I wondered whether to just chuck that bastard’s food bundle away, the boy boldly held out both his little hands toward Cheongpung.

hunks.baseline: Look at that. Grandfathers united everyone.
hunks.sol: Look at that. Grandpas, united as one.

hunks.baseline: After happily tearing into the meat, the boy looked at us with a gaze full of lingering regret.
hunks.sol: After happily tearing into the lean meat, the boy looked at us with lingering desire plastered all over his face.

hunks.baseline: [^1]: A clan village is a settlement where many households share the same family name and ancestral lineage.
hunks.sol:
[^1]: A jiazi is the sixty-year cycle of the traditional calendar; a full jiazi means sixty years.
[^2]: A clan village is a settlement where many households share the same family name and ancestral lineage.
